name: vet-med-ppt-team
description: Five-member teaching-PPT engineering team that turns any subject-domain topic into stage-gated, evidence-verified, classroom-ready slide solutions with human-in-the-loop confirmation. The animal-medicine workspace is a test bench, not a product boundary: the workflow is designed to be portable across vocational/tertiary subject domains (animal-medicine today, swinemedicine/pet/aquaculture tomorrow, or any pedagogical subject with adequate evidence base).
